# dsh-plugin-balance-badge

Always-visible **DeepSeek account balance** for DeepSeek Harness. A small pill in
the top-left windo

w strip of the sidebar shows the same *Topped-up balance* as
**Settings → Account**, and keeps itsel

e sidebar shows the same *Topped-up balance* as
**Settings → Account**, and keeps itself up to date.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Features

- **Same number as Settings → Account** — reads the DeepSeek account Remote, not a
separate/provider

-specific API.
- **Refreshes itself**: on load, every 60 s while the page is visible, immediately wh

en
the window regains focus, and immediately when the stored account credential changes
(sign-in, si

gn-out, grant rotation). Click the pill to refresh on demand.
- **Backs off when the network does**:

a failed read retries after 15 s, then 30 s, 60 s and
at most 120 s, so an outage is not polled at

the normal cadence. One success resets it.
- **Freshness you can see**: the tooltip reads `Updated 1

1:34 PM (5 min ago)` and keeps the
relative part current without spending a request.
- **Honest stat

es**: `…` while loading, `--` when signed out / unavailable, and the last
known amount plus a "stale

" hint when a refresh fails — never a fake zero.
- **Bonus balance** is shown separately in the tool

tip (only when positive), exactly like
Settings → Account; it is never added to the topped-up amount

.
- **Localized** (en / ru / zh) and styled with Harness theme tokens, so it follows the
active them

e and language.
- **Accessible by default**: the amount is a polite live region, so it is announced

when it
changes; the pill keeps a focus ring and a descriptive `aria-label`.
- Pure presentation: no
tools, no config, no Host service of its own.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.x` with the DeepSeek account feature available
(the same feature that render

s Settings → Account).
- On the macOS desktop build the pill sits in the window strip; on Web/Window

s/Linux
shells it is placed beside the Settings row at the sidebar foot instead.

## Uninstall

Remove the dependency entry and the bundle name from the profile `package.json`,
remove `node_module

s/dsh-plugin-balance-badge` (and the lockfile importer entry if
you edited it by hand), then restart

gin-balance-badge` (and the lockfile importer entry if
you edited it by hand), then restart the app.
## How it works
| Piece | Detail |
| Data | `ctx.remote.account.getState()` (local credential read) → `ctx.remote.account.getBalance({

version, locale, timezoneOffsetSeconds })` only while signed in |
| Host chain | `accountController`
→ `deepseekAccount` → Platform `GET /api/v0/users/get_user_summary` (`normal_wallets` / `bonus_wall

ets`) |
| Placement (macOS) | frame slot `shell.overlay`, entry `balance-badge`, fixed at the window

strip next to the traffic lights |
| Placement (other) | `sidebar.footer.action`, beside Settings (

rail-aware) |
| Rendering | plain React from the page module table; no `@deepseek-ai/*` import |
| R
efresh | one shared poller per plugin (single-flight, 15 s floor, stale results dropped, paused whil
e hidden, 15→120 s backoff while reads fail) |

The module is a browser artifact for the Harness module table
(`window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, f

actory })`) plus an empty Host row
(`index.js` = `export function apply() {}`).
